_comment: THE product identity. Change `name` here and rebuild: every page title, meta tag, footer, export, manifest, extension and the OG image (npm run og) follow. Never put this name in a storage key or a file-format id; backup.js keeps its own fixed FORMAT_ID so a rename never breaks restore. `supportEmail` is the address customers write to; replace it with a dedicated support inbox. `seller` is deliberately EMPTY (owner, 11 Oct 2026: the owner's name is not displayed anywhere); the policy pages, the invoice and the receipts name the trading name only. Do not put a person's name back here without the owner asking. `address` and `gstin` are optional and EMPTY while the seller is an individual not registered for GST: invoices are then a Bill of Supply. Fill `gstin` only when registered (and add a tax-invoice mode, schema §28 note).
